personality_one_liner: Clinical white and clean aesthetics layered with deep human trust, delivering premium medical-cosmetic D2C value.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a premium feel. Use md for inner padding and lg/xl for outer container margins to keep content readable and clinical.

do's: Use glass overlay on the sticky bottom CTA container over scrolling content.
Use glass on header when scrolling.
dont's: Do not use blur on body cards or text areas to maintain clinical readability.

screens.name: LandingPage
screens.purpose: A high-converting single-product D2C landing page that establishes clinical trust and emotional connection.

states.loading: Centered spinner with clinical white background.
states.error: Error loading product data. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: 1. Hero: Full width background image (confident mother) with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Headline and subheadline anchored in bottom 40%. Sticky primary CTA fixed at bottom root with glass background. 2. Agitation Cards: 3 full-width single-column cards (surfaceSecondary) stacked vertically with md gap. 3. Clinical Evidence: Grid/Flex row highlighting big stats (95%, 88%) with journal citation below, followed by an interactive Before/After image slider using PanGesture/ScrollView. 4. Checkout Widget: Tiered tab view (Subscribe vs Clinic) to select pricing option and 'Proceed to Secure Checkout' button. 5. Accordions: Standard collapsible sections for FAQs. 6. Footer: Clean links and clinical disclaimers.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Secure mock checkout flow saving the order.
screens.layout: Standard single-column form. Order summary at top, shipping details inputs, mock Apple/Google Pay buttons. 'Place Order' CTA fixed at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

before_scar.alt: Close up of skin with scar texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Design follows '1 iOS-Native Clean' with a clinical, modern medical vibe (surface #FFFFFF, onSurface #1C1C1E, brand #004B87). No other blues or purples permitted.

Implement a sticky primary CTA ('Order Now — Try BioRNA-C') inside a fixed container at the root of the LandingPage screen, ensuring it stays visible over scrolling content and accounts for safe areas.
For the hero image, apply a mandatory top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so text overlays cleanly.
Build the Before/After interactive comparison using a draggable slider layout or side-by-side horizontal scroll for mobile simplicity.
Ensure 'big numbers' in the Clinical Evidence section utilize the 2xl text sizes (Satoshi 500 max weight) for maximum visual impact.
Use Phosphor icons. Keep borders minimal (0.5pt to 1pt max) to maintain the clean medical aesthetic.
